svg.title: MyOTA entity relationships
svg.desc: Three databases shown as bands. Each band lists the tables owned by one service, with primary and foreign keys. Cross-database references are opaque identifiers with no foreign key constraint.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Each band is one database with exactly one owning service. Amber identifiers cross databases as opaque ids — no foreign key, no distributed transaction.
